scope: Only retained development VAL RICH EXO three windows; no TEST arrays, no GPU, no training or source changes. Descriptive diagnosis cannot establish dataset-wide failure or causal effect of IK.
retention: Keep final checkpoint, parent, both validation arrays and configs for planned expanded VAL; no promotion or cleanup performed.

actual_training_exposure.interpretation: RICH saw only 215/2000 examples under sqrt-count corpus weights; possible coverage/domain imbalance, not evidence that balancing alone fixes the failures.

established: Observation, reference, rest and truth arrays are identical between baseline and final for each case/regime. The degradation is not a mismatched-input artifact.
ParkingLot phonetalk improves both regimes; yoga and wipingchairs worsen hidden MPJPE both regimes. There are only three distinct RICH recordings.
All three cases improve root position and root rotation; subtracting root translation still leaves worse hidden error on yoga and wipingchairs. A global translation explanation is insufficient.
Final clean visible MPJPE is near 0.28--1.10mm, but hidden feet/ankles can worsen. Overall/world or visible metrics can hide the conditional completion failure.
RICH noisy hidden dataset delta is dominated by yoga, and RICH clean delta by wipingchairs; leave-one-out estimates change sign.

Final adapter is frozen-base/internal-route, EGO serialized outputs remain exact, and final single-file CPU load/recheck SHA match. Failure here is EXO completion quality, not loss of EGO or checkpoint corruption.

All RICH EXO cases have zero observed-rotation fraction. In yoga the right knee is visible but both right ankle and foot are absent for 57 consecutive frames; wipingchairs left and right have corresponding 66/81-frame gaps. position_proximal ancestry includes only descendants: when both distal joints are absent, knee angular correction strength is exactly zero for that leg. Raising the same observed-position IK gain cannot create missing knee-rotation information.

supported_hypotheses.hypothesis: Learning stronger visible-joint fitting while the occluded lower-leg configuration stays underconstrained can move hidden limbs to worse articulated solutions.
supported_hypotheses.support: Six-iteration IK (gain .9) acts on available position residuals only. All rotation observations here are absent. For knee-visible/ankle-and-foot-hidden spans, the knee has no observed descendants, so its IK strength is exactly zero and lower-leg direction depends on generated pose. Strong fitting of visible joints therefore cannot certify the invisible ankle/foot.
supported_hypotheses.boundary: Same IK is enabled in both baseline and final. Saved arrays contain only final DDIM predictions and references, not the unconstrained x0 at each denoise step. These observations do not identify IK as the cause; require matched adapter-on/off and IK-strength ablation on a wider VAL.

supported_hypotheses.hypothesis: Short adapter training has uneven corpus/action/occlusion coverage and may favor dominant training distributions.
supported_hypotheses.support: RICH comprises 215/2000 actual training examples, versus TRUMANS1163 and EgoBody622; noisy yoga failure is an articulated lower-limb outlier.
supported_hypotheses.boundary: Three RICH windows cannot establish a dataset-wide failure or prove corpus reweighting is sufficient.

not_supported: Uniform motion collapse/freezing: yoga bilateral RMS increases above GT while wipingchairs clean decreases below GT; the directions differ.
Degradation entirely due to root placement: root improves, and root-translation-removed hidden error still worsens.
General model failure based on three windows; or accepting/rejecting every checkpoint based on a single tiny development panel.
next_evaluation_without_training: Freeze a broader recording-separated development panel before seeing candidate scores; stratify movement and occlusion, preserving these windows as fixed anchors.

Evaluate retained parent, full-finetune EXO specialist and adapter candidate on identical windows/noise/seeds; publish per-recording distributions and lower-limb conditional errors in addition to weighted means.
Do not choose a new winner by repeatedly optimizing thresholds or checkpoints on these same three RICH cases. Keep evaluation/selection and eventual held-out reporting distinct.

IK_source_evidence.mechanism: ancestry[end,node] is true only for proper descendants, strength=max(weight*ancestry) over observed end joints, angular delta multiplied by strength; knee position does not constrain its own rotation. Reference lower-limb angles are also inferred from positions rather than directly observed.

deployment_confirmation.observer_status: completed; report rerender returned1 for valid negative acceptance
